meta.summary: A neighborhood record shop's flyer pinned by the register: cream paper, plum ink, one hit of record-label red. Fraunces for the wordmark and headlines, Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else. Draft for the Nov 27 poster spike; check against palette.json.

concept: A flyer pinned by the register of a record shop that's been there for years: paper that's been handled, plum ink, a red dot like a record label.

cream.name: Sleeve cream
cream.role: Paper. The ground of every post and poster.
cream.rule: Cream does most of the work, because the brand reads as printed paper first.

plum.name: Plum ink
plum.role: Headlines, body, the logo on light grounds.
plum.rule: All small type is plum on cream (about 14:1). The logo is plum only on cream or light paper: plum on plum disappears.

red.name: Label red
red.role: One accent: a word of the headline, a date box, bullet dots, the record label.
red.rule: Red is the record label in the logo, so it means 'this one'. One red idea per post; large type (48px+) or marks only.

pine.name: Pine (seasonal)
pine.role: Holiday pieces only: a painted band or a sprig.
pine.rule: Seasonal, not core. Only when the brief is a holiday piece, and only as art or a band with cream type on it (about 9:1).

avoid.reason: Red type on plum is muddy (about 2:1) and unreadable at any size.
The logo on a plum ground vanishes. On plum, the logo goes cream.

roles.note: Maps the shared post templates' color roles to this brand's colors.
roles.heading: plum
roles.label: cream
